prompt.en: Which rewrite starts with the intro?

what_to_do.en: Tap the sentence that moved the first part.

stages.choice_rule: Write four unique full-sentence rewrites of the stem. Exactly one moves the whole introductory time or place part to the front, keeps a comma after that part, and keeps the same meaning and tense. The other three must be clearly wrong: jumbled order, only part of the phrase moved, the wrong phrase moved, or a meaning flip. Use only the roots wordlist plus allowed_extra_words. Keep every choice a whole-word kid sentence. Never use teaching words.

choices: After lunch, we play ball.
We after play ball lunch.
Lunch we play after ball.
Play after we lunch ball.

gold_items.stem: I read a book before bed.
choices: I before read a book bed.
Before bed, I read a book.
Bed I read before a book.
Read a book I before bed.

gold_items.stem: The kids run in the park.
choices: The in park kids run.
Kids the run park in.
In the park, the kids run.
Run the kids in park.
After school, <NAME> rode a bike.
<NAME> after rode a bike school.
After <NAME> rode, a bike school.
School after, <NAME> rode a bike.

gold_items.stem: We watch the moon at night.
choices: We at watch the moon night.
Night we watch at the moon.
At we night, watch the moon.
At night, we watch the moon.

gold_items.stem: She cleaned her desk before dinner.
choices: She before cleaned her desk dinner.
Before dinner, she cleaned her desk.
Dinner she cleaned before her desk.
Before she dinner, cleaned her desk.

gold_items.stem: The puppy hid under the table.
choices: Under the table, the puppy hid.
The table, the puppy hid under.
Under the puppy, hid the table.
The puppy, hid under the table.

gold_items.stem: We put on boots when it is cold.
choices: When we put on boots, it is cold.
Inside, we put on boots when cold.
When it is cold, we put on boots.
When it, we put on boots is cold.

roots: Offer four unique rewrites. Exactly one moves the whole intro time or place part to the front, adds a comma, and keeps the same meaning.
Never change the actor, tense, or what happened. Wrong choices may jumble words, move only part of the phrase, move the wrong phrase, or flip the meaning.
Do not put the original stem in the choices. Do not make two choices differ only by a comma.
Keep stems and choices in the kid world: school, home, food, pets, play, family, weather. No brands and no real names.
Never use teaching words such as sentence, comma, introductory, rewrite, phrase, or clause in the stem or choices.
Tier 3 distractors must be near misses: a moved wrong phrase or a when or while clause that flips the meaning.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of four to six words. Use a clear after, before, or in phrase at the end. Wrong choices are obvious word jumbles.
tier_rules.2: Stems of six to eight words. Mix time and place phrases and irregular past. One distractor parks the intro in the middle or splits it.
tier_rules.3: Near misses with under, when, while, or during. Distractors move the wrong phrase or flip the meaning of a when or while clause.

intro_first.en: Move the time or place part to the front. Then write the rest.
intro_first.ko: 시간이나 장소 말을 앞으로 옮긴 뒤 나머지를 쓰세요.

wrong_phrase.en: Move the time or place part, not the other words.
wrong_phrase.ko: 다른 말이 아니라 시간이나 장소 말을 앞으로 옮기세요.

meaning_change.en: Keep the same meaning. Only move the intro part to the front.
meaning_change.ko: 뜻은 그대로 두고 앞말만 문장 앞으로 옮기세요.

jumble.en: Keep the same words. Just move the first part to the start.
jumble.ko: 같은 단어를 쓰고 앞부분만 맨 앞으로 옮기세요.
